item.title: RyukGram Side by Side v446.0.0
item.description:
Instagram 446.0.0 | RyukGram v1.4.0 (side-by-side, no plugins) — fallback snapshot of the developer's source.
The same build under its own bundle identifier so it installs next to the real Instagram app. See the live RyukSign source for the full release notes.
